description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Cancels a booking on behalf of the business and notifies the client. Always ask the owner to confirm first. Use it for a booking that was already confirmed; a request that waits for an answer is declined with owner_decide_booking. A customer cancelling their own booking uses cancel_booking.

reason.description: Why: the client sees it in the message they get

name: owner_cancel_booking
title: Cancel a confirmed booking
